ja216:1.1: It is not this fire that burns me,
ja216:1.2: nor the spit that is well fashioned,
ja216:1.3: But my lady thinking of me:
ja216:2.1: The fire of lust it is that burns me,
ja216:2.2: and my heart it does torment.
ja216:2.3: Fisherman, master, free me, there is no pleasure in being killed.
